lines.en: - We're over. - Anybody but me would punch you right in the head.
I understand you put some flyers up all over the school.
Why would you photo-dock my head onto the body of a rhinoceros?
A hippo has fatter thighs and a whiter snout.
If you ever need a laugh...
And never mind the things I've done.
I figure the sooner I get all this equipment out of here, the sooner I can take it down.
And never mind the sooner I can take it down.
Uh, is it supposed to do that?
Will you come with me to the smoothie to look for my laptop?
Yeah, sure, just let me go to the restroom.
No, you're going to wash my face.
No, Sam, Sam, I don't like the smoothie.
You know, anybody but me would punch you right in the head.
Which is why you are my best friend.
Oh, it's all right, the nails will work right through your shirt.
No, Sam, Sam, I don't want to do it.
I don't want to try it.
We'll do so many times, I don't want to try things, and then...
Um, we had some trouble putting the video online,
so here's a DVD of every kid who auditioned on Saturday.
I'll try not to poke a hole in this with my pointy bosoms.
Shouldn't you girls be getting to class by now?
Shouldn't you be married by now?
Well, good to see you, Miss Briggs.
Um, can we get your autograph?
Hey, hey, look who's back from the dance!
This is a crazy hat spaghetti taco party!
We're going to have a taco!
Colonel Shea, it's an honor to meet you.
Tebow lives across the hall with Freddie and his mother.
So are you dating Freddie's mother?
Would you guys just quit fighting and make up already?
I've got nothing to apologize for.
I have as much of a right to Freddie as you.
Come on, Freddie, let's go to study hall.
You can't just take Freddie whenever you want him.
Maybe we should let Freddie decide who he wants to go with.
It's not fair to make him choose between us.
I just thought you were a different kind of guy.
The kind that doesn't collect pee-wee babies.
Okay, look, if you can't accept my hobby, then maybe we should break up.
Don't break up with us, Carly!
So, you don't want me to be your girlfriend?
I think we should wait a while.
Till I'm out of this cast and this whole hero thing wears off.
And then, if you still want to be my girlfriend,
I'd be really psyched about it.
Come down from there before you hurt yourself.
No worries, I got my leg wrapped around this pipe.
And you have a crazy fever.
I'm Carly Shay and this is our very first webcast of a little show we call iCarly.
So, till we see you again...
Keep your sock full of butter.
And if you're attacked by a moose...
Oh my God, I'm being attacked by a moose!
